verdict.rationale: Orama's docs explicitly describe hybrid search as full-text and vector search in one query, with the results combined. The GitHub README lists Hybrid Search alongside BM25 full-text and vector search, and Orama Cloud also offers hybrid search with automatic embeddings, as does the embeddings plugin for orama-js. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid result quality, and documented detail on the fusion/weighting mechanism.
